name: claynsn-agent-discovery-mcp
description: Minimal MCP server (~250 lines TS) for ERC-8004 agent discovery + x402 payment. Three tools: `find_agents_by_skill` (via 8004scan public API), `get_agent_card`, `call_agent_with_payment` using Coinbase's official `x402-fetch`. Direct EOA signing — no smart account, no bundler, no relay. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Cursor, Cline. USDC on Base/Ethereum + testnets, MIT.
